title: Practice 7: Perfective or imperfective? The prefixed verbs in use

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: We left in protest.
exercises.why: **ушли** — past tense (plural) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Ships were passing under the bridge.
exercises.why: **проплывали** — past tense (plural) of проплывать: imperfective (perfective partner: проплыть).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: We made it to the top three.
exercises.why: **вошли** — past tense (plural) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Tom ended his own life.
exercises.why: **свёл** — past tense (masculine) of свести: perfective (imperfective partner: сводить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: She guided me to the palace.
exercises.why: **провела** — past tense (feminine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: We climbed a steep slope.
exercises.why: **влезли** — past tense (plural) of влезть: perfective (imperfective partner: влезать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Who translated the Quran into Hebrew?
exercises.why: **перевёл** — past tense (masculine) of перевести: perfective (imperfective partner: переводить).

exercises.q: I went there dozens of times.
exercises.why: **приходил** — past tense (masculine) of приходить: imperfective (perfective partner: прийти).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: I came into the abandoned house.
exercises.why: **вошёл** — past tense (masculine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: He couldn't bear to be apart from her.
exercises.why: **выносил** — past tense (masculine) of выносить: imperfective (perfective partner: вынести).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Firefighters came to the rescue.
exercises.why: **пришли** — past tense (plural) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Their ship struck a rock.
exercises.why: **налетел** — past tense (masculine) of налететь: perfective (imperfective partner: налетать).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: My heart sank into my boots.
exercises.why: **ушла** — past tense (feminine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Haven't you been to the supermarket?
exercises.why: **заезжали** — past tense (plural) of заезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: заехать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: I wonder where Joe went?
exercises.why: **ушёл** — past tense (masculine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: We made it to the top five.
exercises.why: **вошли** — past tense (plural) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: He came from the Northeast.
exercises.why: **пришел** — past tense (masculine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Haven't you been to the supermarket?
exercises.why: **заезжал** — past tense (masculine) of заезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: заехать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: He spent seven years in Siberia.
exercises.why: **провёл** — past tense (masculine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: What ship did Tom arrive on?
exercises.why: **приплыл** — past tense (masculine) of приплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: приплывать).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
